name: Landscaping

seo.title: Top-Rated Landscaping in Sioux Falls, SD
seo.description: Compare local Sioux Falls landscaping companies with hours, phone numbers, reviews, and guides to hiring right for South Dakota yards.

intro:
Sioux Falls yards face a lot. The freeze and thaw cycle heaves edging and cracks hardscaping every spring, clay soil drains poorly and compacts hard, and summer winds dry out new plantings faster than most people expect. A good landscaper here knows those conditions before they ever show up at your door.

Whether you want a full yard design, seasonal cleanup, sod installation, or ongoing maintenance, the landscaping companies listed here are locally owned and working in this community daily.
tips: Ask whether the company designs and installs, maintains, or does both, so you know who to call after the project is finished.
Find out what plants they typically use and whether they favor species that handle South Dakota winters without heavy protection.
Ask how they handle clay soil, since poor drainage is one of the most common yard problems in Sioux Falls and not every contractor addresses it at installation.
Get a written quote that breaks out labor, materials, and any annual maintenance fees separately before you sign anything.

faqs.q: When is the best time to hire a landscaper in Sioux Falls?
faqs.a: Spring is the busiest season, so contacting a company in late winter gives you the best chance of getting on the schedule before the rush. Fall is also a good time for planting trees and shrubs because cooler temperatures and fall rains help roots establish before the ground freezes.

faqs.q: How much does landscaping cost in Sioux Falls?
faqs.a: Costs vary widely depending on the scope of work, yard size, and materials chosen. Ask each company for an itemized quote and compare them, and ask whether the estimate includes soil amendment for clay-heavy ground, which adds cost but matters a lot here.

faqs.q: Do landscaping companies in Sioux Falls also do snow removal?
faqs.a: Many local landscaping companies offer snow removal as a seasonal service, so it is worth asking if you want one company handling your yard year round. Confirm what equipment they use and whether your driveway and walkway dimensions are a good fit before the first snowfall.

faqs.q: What should I know about watering new landscaping in Sioux Falls?
faqs.a: New sod and freshly planted trees need consistent moisture, and Sioux Falls summers can include stretches of heat and wind that dry soil out quickly. Ask your landscaper for a specific watering schedule for the first season and whether an irrigation system makes sense for your yard.

faqs.q: Can a landscaper fix my yard after a wet spring?
faqs.a: Yes, and this is a common request in Sioux Falls where flat lots and clay soil trap water after snowmelt or heavy rain. Solutions range from regrading and adding drainage tile to building raised beds or dry creek features, so ask the company to walk your yard and explain what they recommend before you decide.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for landscaping work in Sioux Falls?
faqs.a: Permits are typically required for projects that involve grading, retaining walls above a certain height, or work near a floodplain, including areas close to the Big Sioux River. Ask your landscaper and check with the City of Sioux Falls permitting office to confirm what your specific project requires before work begins.
